replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body: Although in most cases that is true, this map appears to be far wider than Senex, making it better to have a middle island. The middle island in Senex is annoying because the spawns are not very wide, but for a map like this I think an island would improve gameplay. Honestly, looking back at the map I think it will play great with or without one :)
